quote: Ballots in an official drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day are guaranteed on time. If you need to mail your ballot, we recommend mailing it more than a week before Election Day. After that, use a ballot drop box. ... You can return your mail ballot in person to a county elections office or voting center.
en: A mailed ballot still counts if it's postmarked by November 3, but a postmark isn't guaranteed the day you mail it. This close, the Secretary of State says to use a drop box instead. A ballot in an official drop box by 8 p.m. on November 3 is on time, and you can also hand it in at a county elections office or voting center. Find locations at VoteWA.gov.
es: Una boleta por correo todavía cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes, pero el matasellos no está garantizado el mismo día que la envías. A estas alturas, la Secretaría de Estado recomienda usar un buzón de entrega. Una boleta que está en un buzón oficial a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre llega a tiempo, y también puedes entregarla en la oficina electoral de tu condado o en un centro de votación. Busca los lugares en VoteWA.gov.
notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Postmark rule after the U.S. Supreme Court decision: sos.wa.gov news 2026 (former src). Watson v. RNC docket: judgment reversed June 29, 2026; no new entry Oct 23 to 30.

quote: How do provisional ballots work in Washington? You can register in person on Election Day and get a regular ballot, so provisional ballots are not common. Counties issue provisional ballots when they need to check your eligibility to participate in the election.
en: They're not common in Washington. Name not on the list, or need to update your address? You can register in person until 8 p.m. on Election Day at a county elections office or voting center and get a regular ballot. Counties give a provisional ballot only when they need to check whether you can vote.
es: No son comunes en Washington. ¿Tu nombre no está en la lista o necesitas cambiar tu dirección? Puedes registrarte en persona hasta las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones en la oficina electoral de tu condado o en un centro de votación y recibir una boleta regular. Los condados dan una boleta provisional solo cuando necesitan revisar si puedes votar.
notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Same FAQ: 'You can register in person until 8 p.m. on Election Day to participate in that election.' and 'Locate your nearest voting center by checking VoteWA.gov or contacting your county elections office.'

quote: To be counted, all ballots must either be put into a drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day or postmarked by Election Day and received within the 7-day post-election grace period.
en: A mailed ballot counts if it's postmarked by November 3 and reaches your county by November 10. Since October 28, the Secretary of State recommends a drop box instead. Drop boxes take ballots until 8 p.m. on November 3. If you have to mail it, ask a post office staff member to hand-stamp the postmark.
es: Una boleta por correo cuenta si tiene matasellos del 3 de noviembre o antes y llega a tu condado a más tardar el 10 de noviembre. Desde el 28 de octubre, la Secretaría de Estado recomienda usar un buzón de entrega. Los buzones reciben boletas hasta las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre. Si tienes que enviarla por correo, pide a un empleado de la oficina postal que le ponga el matasellos a mano.
notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Nov 10: SOS 2026 Elections Calendar. Drop Box Locator: sos.oregon.gov/elections/Pages/drop-box-locator.aspx.

quote: Your mail ballot must received by the clerk’s office on or before 8:00 p.m. on Election Day, November 3, 2026. Ballots received after November 3, 2026 will not be counted. You can also drop your ballot off at a drop box location before 8:00 p.m. on Election Day.
en: It may be. Your county clerk must receive a mailed ballot by 8 p.m. on November 3, whatever the postmark, and ballots that arrive later don't count. Instead, put it in a drop box or take it to a polling location before 8 p.m. that day.
es: Puede que sí. La oficina del secretario de tu condado debe recibir la boleta por correo a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre, sin importar el matasellos, y las que llegan después no cuentan. Mejor déjala en un buzón de entrega o llévala a un lugar de votación antes de las 8 p. m. de ese día.
notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Polling place ballot box: Utah Code 20A-3a-204(3) (Perplexity lead) and the former src, the 2026 Voter Information Pamphlet.

quote: Your provisional ballot is counted if you complete the provisional ballot affidavit and the election official confirms your eligibility to vote. Note: Your provisional ballot will NOT count if you vote in the wrong county, and choose to vote a provisional ballot rather than vote in the correct county. ... The election judge will give you a receipt when you cast a provisional ballot. This receipt specifies how you determine the status of your provisional ballot.
en: You vote one when your eligibility can't be confirmed, for example if you register on Election Day without ID that can be verified. Not on the list? You can register or update your record at a voter service and polling center through Election Day. A provisional ballot counts once officials confirm you can vote, but not if you vote it in the wrong county. Your receipt tells you how to check it.
es: Votas con una cuando no se puede confirmar si tienes derecho a votar, por ejemplo, si te registras el Día de las Elecciones sin una identificación que se pueda verificar. ¿No estás en la lista? Puedes registrarte o actualizar tus datos en un centro de votación y servicio al votante hasta el Día de las Elecciones. Una boleta provisional cuenta cuando los funcionarios confirman que puedes votar, pero no si la votas en el condado equivocado. Tu comprobante te dice cómo revisarla.
notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Election Day registration and the ID case: coloradosos.gov/pubs/elections/FAQs/ElectionDay.html Q8 ('If you try to register to vote on Election Day, but do not have verifiable identification, you may vote a provisional ballot.') and the reg FAQ.
